title: Italian Bacon and Egg Toast
description: A simple Italian-inspired breakfast dish featuring crispy bacon, scrambled eggs, and toasted bread.
instructions: 1. Cook the Irish bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
2. Remove the cooked bacon from the pan and set aside.
3. Crack the eggs into the same pan and scramble them until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the slices of bread.
5. Assemble the dish by placing toasted bread on a plate, topping with scrambled eggs, and finishing with crispy bacon.
6. Drizzle with butter or oil if desired.
